purpose: Seventeenth-pass official and first-party verification for six existing Batch-51 rows while the same V53 task remains pickup-timeout claimable. No second task, runner, checkpoint advancement, exact-parcel promotion or parcel-value publication is performed.

method.official_source_policy: Only primary auction records, current first-party operator pages, NHS or CQC records, Companies House records and official local-authority planning routes are promoted. Search snippets and directory-only claims are not promoted.
method.current_status_policy: A current website, company registration, regulated registration, recruitment advert or planning record can verify identity or activity but does not by itself prove executed lease terms, legal completion or exact parcel geometry.
method.parcel_binding_policy: NO_DATA_NOT_INFERRED until exact title or canonical geometry is read.
